description: Expected AI output for a generic table component. The response lists only cells the AI intends to fill. Table configuration, cell render actions, row/column content policies, and PowerPoint structure are defined by the component's tag_context.table_config.

cells.description: The table cells to fill, keyed by "row,col" (zero-based, e.g. "0,1"). Use only the row/column coordinates provided in this table instance's tag_context.table_config, one key per cell. Each value is an object with only an items array.

propertyNames.description: A cell coordinate key "row,col" (zero-based integers), matching a render cell from this table instance context.

items.description: Text items for this cell. Use one item for plain text cells. Use one or more items for paragraph, bullets, or numbered_list cells. Do not return schema, configuration, explanations, or preserved cell content.
